original_record.title: Astrological aspects in the horoscopes of 102 anthroposophic pioneers
original_record.dataset_name_or_description: Same 102 anthroposophic pioneers for all five pair tests; Steiner natal aspects used to select pairs
original_record.likely_dataset_reuse: All five rows share 102 pioneers and Steiner reference chart
original_record.birth_data_source: unknown birth hour; calculated at 12:00 GMT
original_record.predictor_definition: Difference of slow minus fast ecliptic longitude, rounded to nearest degree; 24 sectors of 15°; original Steiner aspects allowed up to 13° orb; selected aspect pairs from chart dated 25 Feb 1861 noon.
original_record.statistical_method: normality test; post hoc harmonic analysis and chi-square; UA also reports runs tests
original_record.multiplicity_handling: five selected pairs; harmonic periods selected after viewing results; no correction stated
original_record.sufficient_statistics: 102 observations split into 24 15° sectors; raw 24-bin counts not printed in text
original_record.original_reported_result: Original normality test p=0.012; author also reports post-selected 30°, 90° or 120° harmonic patterns and chi-square significance for all pairs except Moon–Saturn.
original_record.ua_interpretation: UA reanalysis finds no significant runs pattern (mean runs-test p=0.26), mean correlation among distributions −0.01 and Steiner aspects not consistently at peaks.
original_record.ua_criticism: Normal distribution is inappropriate astronomical null; no birth years or matched control; selection of tested periods after observing data invalidates p; Steiner birth date later documented as 27 Feb 1861 ~11:15pm, though some selected aspects remain in orb.
original_record.replication_or_reanalysis_refs: UA p340 reanalysis; Günter Aschoff, Das Goetheanum Nr 9/2009 (Steiner birth provenance)
original_record.algorithmic_relevance: High: planetary-pair aspect periodicity, aspect orbs, temporal astronomical null.
original_record.candidate_feature_or_constraint: Specify aspect families/phase bins and birth-cohort-preserving null in advance; propagate Moon time uncertainty; obtain original 102 births.
original_record.full_text_status: review excerpt only; original not retrieved
original_record.extraction_notes: Original p is normality test, not evidence for a preregistered specific aspect. Direction refers to that original p only.

original_record.outcome_exact: Longitude/declination error in uncorrected ephemeris position
original_record.effect_size: Moon parallax can reach about 1°; roughly half of charts have ~0.5° error; celestial latitude can alter longitude by up to ±0.25 arcmin and declination by ±5 arcmin; lunar distance changes parallax about ±5%.

original_record.ua_interpretation: A real astronomical correction, not evidence that corrected positions improve prediction.

original_record.algorithmic_relevance: Technical definition needed before any small-orb Moon feature is reproduced.
original_record.candidate_feature_or_constraint: Calculate both geocentric and topocentric Moon; freeze frame choice; sensitivity-test within birth-location/time uncertainty.
